{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# NOTE: The PBS script uses $1 (partition argument) and has some directives commented out.
# This Flux script keeps the same required positional argument.

PART_ARG="${1:-}"

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l nodes=1:ppn=15     -> -N 1 -n 1 -c 15
#   -l walltime=00:30:00  -> -t 30m
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 15 -t 30m --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner $PART_ARG")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  PART="${2:?missing argument}"

  # NOTE: PBS -A GT-rbras6-CODA20 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  # NOTE: PBS -l mem=20gb not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: PBS -j oe not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  /bin/echo Running on host: "$(hostname)."
  /bin/echo In directory: "$(pwd)"
  /bin/echo Starting on: "$(date)"

  source activate ~/venvs/pydask

  /bin/echo Parition "$PART"

  flux run -n 1 -c 15 python /storage/coda1/p-rbras6/0/njadidoleslam3/projects/stochsm/model_simulations/postprocess/create_unified_data.py "$PART"
fi
"
}
